desc: PLAN-APPROVED but blocked: ticket 005 failed at the no-Linux-output boundary, so replacement maxcpus=2 ticket 123 must pass before reviewed ticket-120 all-core artifacts can exist. Then run one all-14-core bring-up with idle=nop and the proven polling console. Pass = 0-13 online with correct 4E+5P+5P mapping, task liveness on each cluster, watchdog and shell stable. No cpufreq, IRQ-console, USB/storage, PCIe, or new hardware operation. Requires exact hashes, independent review, healthy rig, and lease. PREP 2026-07-30: discriminating DTB built (t6040-j614s-dcuart-c2probe.dtb, P0 siblings status=fail so maxcpus=6 reaches cluster 2). One rig cycle: v4 kernel + c2probe.dtb + untouched initramfs, maxcpus=6. Boots -> fault is P0-sibling-specific AND all three cpufreq policies register; faults -> count/second-cluster-based. REFRAME 2026-08-03: NOT specifically an unpack_to_rootfs bug. The same fault hits copy-on-write in ordinary userspace (copy_page -> do_wp_page -> SIGSEGV of the first process after switch_root) with a 1.8 MB initramfs and no unpack pressure at all. maxcpus=1 clean; 3/4/5 fail non-monotonically = a RACE. Rewrite around CoW/MM corruption under SMP on t6040; unpack_to_rootfs is one symptom. This is now the SINGLE blocker for the whole daily driver (see 204).
author: codex
progress: 2026-07-29 RUN: kernel side PASSES — 'smp: Brought up 1 node, 14 CPUs' and 'SMP: Total of 14 processors activated', with per-CPU MPIDR+part IDs giving the measured topology 4E (cluster0, cpus1-4, part 0x054) + 5P (cluster1, cpu0+5-8, 0x055) + 5P (cluster2, cpus9-13, 0x055) = exactly the expected 4E+5P+5P. m1n1's FDT pass agrees and correctly disables the dead cpu@10105. USERSPACE HALF STILL UNPROVEN: that boot oopsed in 'Unpacking initramfs' because I repacked the initramfs from a NON-ROOT extraction (device nodes silently dropped) - self-inflicted, not an SMP fault. One boot with the untouched initramfs-smp-kmsg-report.cpio.gz at maxcpus=14 completes it. Also recorded: fbcon fails on this kernel/DTB with fb_set_par -16, so console=tty0 shows nothing on the panel and KIS is the only channel. | 2026-07-29 FURTHER: with the FULL driver set (PCIe+WiFi+BT+SD+trackpad HID+SMC) maxcpus=14 hangs BEFORE any console registers — zero console bytes, no shell, panel keeps m1n1's logo — while the byte-identical object at maxcpus=1 gives kernel messages, a shell, and clean WiFi/BT/SD probes. So 14-core bringup works (proven on the thin dcuart-earlycon/PCIe-free config: 'SMP: Total of 14 processors activated' + 4E+5P+5P) but 14 cores PLUS the full driver set does not. Diagnosis needs earlycon on the daily-driver kernel (it has DOCKCHANNEL_NBCON but not the earlycon patch). ALSO: with maxcpus=14 the fan spins up and the chassis warms — expected, because idle=nop makes idle cores SPIN (M4 loses state on WFI/WFE); 14 spinning cores makes cpuidle a PREREQUISITE for usable SMP, ahead of cpufreq (006). KEEP maxcpus=1 in anything enrolled. Evidence: done/2026-07-29-t6040-dwm-ttydc0-getty-and-smp14-limit.md | 2026-07-29 SCOPE CORRECTION (CJ challenged the claim, correctly): the justified statement is 'all 14 cores ENTER THE KERNEL and SMP bringup completes' — each secondary printed its own 'Booted secondary processor' line from secondary_start_kernel with a distinct MPIDR, plus 'Brought up 1 node, 14 CPUs' / 'SMP: Total of 14 processors activated'. NOT proven and never observed: a shell with 14 cores online. cpu_online was read from sysfs only at maxcpus=2 (0-1); a task is proven to have executed only on CPU1; cores 2-13 have never had work scheduled on them; and the single maxcpus=14 boot oopsed 30 ms later. THE ONE BOOT THAT WOULD SETTLE IT: the thin config (Image-dcuart-earlycon + PCIe-free hid-rx-rearm DTB, which reaches userspace fine at maxcpus=2) with the UNTOUCHED initramfs-smp-kmsg-report.cpio.gz at maxcpus=14 -> gives cpu_online 0-13, processor_count 14, and taskset liveness. | 2026-07-29 BISECTED. maxcpus 1/2/5 reach userspace; 6/7/9/14 all die in unpack_to_rootfs with 'Unable to handle kernel write to read-only memory' (level 3 permission fault, WnR=1, pc __pi_memcpy_generic, lr copy_folio_from_iter_atomic). THRESHOLD IS EXACTLY 6. RETRACTION: my earlier claim that this was caused by my non-root-repacked initramfs is WRONG - the untouched 43944ef2 archive that boots fine at maxcpus=2 faults identically at 14. Topology note: maxcpus=5 = boot P core + all 4 E cores (two clusters) and works; maxcpus=6 adds cpu5, the SECOND core in the boot's own cluster (aff1=1, same as cpu0), and that is where it breaks - so neither 'P cores' nor 'crossing clusters' is the explanation. Next experiment: a DTB disabling cpu5-8 so maxcpus=6 brings up cpu9 from a different cluster instead, which discriminates cluster-local state from a plain >5-CPU resource threshold. Evidence: done/2026-07-29-t6040-SMP-threshold-maxcpus6-and-5core-shippable.md
